name: Royal Grand Invite
description: The flagship Royal Grand Invite — a fully interactive animated wedding e-invite. Features peacock motif splash screen, envelope opening reveal, multi-page event schedule (Mehendi, Sangeet, Wedding, Reception), photo gallery, animated countdown timer, and embedded background music. The gold-emerald palette evokes true royal opulence.
imageAlt: Royal Grand interactive animated wedding e-invite with peacock motif
